purpose: Engineering smoke thresholds, not a powered effectiveness trial

schedule.unit_of_analysis: rule instance; repeated temperature-zero calls are operational repeats, not independent game families
schedule.development_and_heldout_scope: two development and two engineering holdout rule templates; all four are public smoke fixtures and permanently excluded from future confirmatory holdouts

gates.schema_measurement: first response on in-scope main trials, before repair; timeout, parse failure, refusal and wrong candidate count count as failure
gates.repair_measurement: first reply to a fixed injected structural error compiles with correct candidate count; semantic accuracy is scored separately
gates.cost_measurement: conservative uncached token estimate; reserve input cap plus output cap before every call, count failed attempts; missing usage blocks progression
gates.progression: all gates must pass; passing allows designing a formal trial, never automatic execution
gates.failure_response: preserve run and revise in a new committed manifest; never change model, thresholds or trial count mid-run
gates.coverage_rate: report all assigned cases; no effectiveness go/no-go threshold in this engineering smoke

cases.rules: Two players each roll one fair six-sided die. Throughout all modeled decision times each sees only their own die and the public bid history. Neither die is revealed during these decisions.
Two dice are rolled and both dice are publicly revealed before any modeled decision. Both players see both dice and the public history at every decision.

At each modeled response decision, a prize is public. Player 0 has secretly submitted a bid and knows that bid. Player 1 cannot see it before responding and alone sees their own hand. Player 0 cannot see player 1's hand. These visibility rules hold throughout this slice.
Both players see an announcement. Only player 1 sees both a signal and its retained private record. Player 0 sees neither. No modeled action reveals them or changes who can observe these fields.

out_of_schema.rules: As in the private one-die game, each player initially sees only their own die. At a modeled decision player 1 may pay a publicly recorded fee to inspect player 0's die. Subsequent decisions of player 1 observe that die; decisions before payment do not. Both phases must be represented under the same field names without splitting or renaming die_0.
out_of_schema.reason: The same die_0 field is invisible to player 1 before payment and visible afterward. A single static public/private partition cannot represent both.
out_of_schema.correct_rejection: strict JSON refusal envelope with expected code and exact validated witness; free-text refusal, unrelated reason, parse errors and forced candidate fitting all fail

taxonomy_policy: multi-label at attempt and final-trial level; raw outputs preserved; precedence for display follows listed order; no posthoc category silently replaces an existing label
system_prompt: Map the supplied rules to the fixed observation vocabulary. Output JSON only. Assign every field exactly once to public_fields or private_fields_by_player.player_0/player_1. Do not invent fields, prior, evidence, reliability or certification. Return the requested number of distinct candidates, using hypothesis_id lowercase identifiers. Candidate envelope: {schema_version:aip-observation-gamespec-candidates-v1,game_id:CASE_ID,candidates:[{hypothesis_id:ID,public_fields:[],private_fields_by_player:{player_0:[],player_1:[]}}]}. If the same field changes visibility within the modeled times and cannot be represented by this static partition, output {schema_version:aip-observation-refusal-v1,game_id:CASE_ID,status:out_of_schema,error_code:OUT_OF_SCHEMA_STATIC_VISIBILITY,witness:{field:FIELD,player:PLAYER,before_visible:BOOLEAN,after_visible:BOOLEAN}}. Never split fields to hide a representational limitation.

feedback_policy.structural: only compiler error code and offending field; no reference owners or semantic witness
feedback_policy.semantic: same structural messages plus a development witness suite separate from final exhaustive evaluation
feedback_policy.final_evaluation: same independent full field-contrast suite for all arms, withheld until trial completion
feedback_policy.structural_probe: start from a registered candidate payload missing exactly one field and provide MISSING_FIELD plus its name; 6 probes in each feedback arm
feedback_policy.missing_truth_control: same initial two incorrect partitions in both feedback arms; up to two repairs may restore true candidate; report initial/final coverage separately

scope_of_certification: observation partition on the frozen finite field vocabulary only; never full game or runtime GTO
